verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs describe the programmatic onboarding flow. A personal customer can be created as a PROSPECT and then activated, KYC/KYB checks run via the API, and SAVING/CHECKING Demand Deposit Accounts are opened through the accounts API. Sandbox API keys work immediately, and sandbox test cases cover the multiple KYC flows. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that deposits are FDIC-insured (only partner banks are mentioned), documented sandbox-to-production parity (sandbox auto-passes KYB), and explicit documentation of account status lifecycle from application to active, plus no independent or hands-on corroboration.
